name: 斑脇田雞

similarSpecies.distinction: 上體較暖橄欖褐、栗色只及頭胸，脅至尾下黑白橫斑較粗而完整；腳暗石板灰、嘴黑。
體型更小、嘴較短；栗紅較集中於頭胸，翼上沒有本種那些白／暗橫斑。

featureNotes: 深冷褐頭頂與栗紅面頸對比（第1圈實際可見）。
大面積栗紅胸腹，僅下脅少量黑白橫斑（第2圈實際可見）。
翼覆羽上少量白色與暗色橫斑（第3圈實際可見；折翼狀態）。
偏橙色調的紅色腿（第4圈實際可見）。

rangeMap.note: Country overview only, not seasonal areas: source gives breeding in northeast China and adjacent Russian Far East (probably North Korea) and wintering in disjunct parts of southeast Asia, Sumatra, Java and Borneo.

sources.use: HKBWS substantive identification/range/conservation read: 20-22cm, darker colder-brown upperparts extending to crown, more extensive chestnut below with less flank-barring, paler orange-toned red legs, greenish bill, some whitish and dark bars on wing coverts; breeds NE China/Russian Far East, winters SE Asia/Sumatra/Java/Borneo; NT, trend no data but suspected decline.
